title: Airport: a trip to London
lead: You fly to London for a conference. At the airport you talk to six people: at check-in, security, on the plane, at passport control, at baggage reclaim and at customs.

words.definition: the place where you give your big bag and get your boarding pass
words.example: First you go to the check-in desk.

words.definition: a big bag for your clothes when you travel
words.example: You have a big blue suitcase and a small bag.

words.definition: the small bag that you take with you on the plane
words.example: Your small bag is your hand luggage.

words.definition: a paper or a phone ticket that you need to get on the plane
the door at the airport where you get on the plane
the place at the airport where officers look at you and your bag before the flight
a flat plastic box for your things at security
words.example: Put your bag in a tray, please.

words.definition: things like water, juice or perfume that you can pour
words.example: Do you have any liquids in your bag?

words.definition: the place where an officer looks at your passport and asks you questions
words.example: You follow the signs to passport control.

words.definition: the answer to the question why
words.example: What is the reason for your visit?

words.definition: the place where you take your suitcase after the flight
words.example: Next, you go to baggage reclaim.

words.definition: the place where officers check the things you bring into a country
to tell customs about the things you bring into a country
something that you give to a friend
words.example: You have a gift for a friend.
